index.source: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566 (1996) (constants in the code); bundled check page other/air/Ciddor

n2Electronic.source: electronic (instantaneous) n2 at 1 bar and 273 K near 800 nm; the original code cites the compilation of Lehmeier 1985 / Borzsonyi 2010 / Wahlstrand 2012; values differ by ~20 % between sources; not re-checked; air as a mixture of N2 and O2

composition.source: mole fractions of dry air (standard atmosphere)

standardAirDispersion.source: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566 (1996), dry-air dispersion: (n-1) 1e8 = k1 / (k0 - s^2) + k3 / (k2 - s^2), s = 1/lambda in 1/um; refractiveindex.info other/air/Ciddor (standard air 15 C, 101.325 kPa, 450 ppm CO2)
standardAirDispersion.verification: the page's coefficients 0.05792105, 238.0185, 0.00167917, 57.362 equal k1 / 1e8, k0, k3 / 1e8, k2; the engine at 15 C, 101325 Pa, dry, 450 ppm equals the page's formula (test CatalogueTests.CiddorAir_AtStandardConditions_EqualsTheDatabaseFormula)

co2Dependence.source: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566 (1996) (dispersion changes by 0.534e-6 per ppm of CO2 about 450 ppm; molar mass of dry air 28.9635 + 12.011e-6 (x_CO2 - 400) g/mol); not re-read
co2Dependence.uncertainty: not compared with the paper; the dry-air index at 633 nm is checked against the paper's value in FoundationTests

waterVaporDispersion.units: (n_ws - 1) 1e8 = cf (w0 + w1 s^2 + w2 s^4 + w3 s^6), s in 1/um
waterVaporDispersion.source: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566 (1996) water-vapour dispersion (w0..w3, cf); not re-read
waterVaporDispersion.uncertainty: humid-air results are not compared with the paper

thermodynamics.source: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566 (1996) (R = 8.314510 J/(mol K), M_w = 0.018015 kg/mol); not re-read
thermodynamics.uncertainty: constants of the paper; transcription not re-read

saturationVapourPressure.units: p_sv = exp(A T^2 + B T + C + D / T) in Pa, T in K
saturationVapourPressure.source: CIPM-2007 / Ciddor 1996 saturation vapour pressure of water; transcription not re-read

enhancementFactor.units: f = a + b p + c t^2, p in Pa, t in degC
enhancementFactor.source: enhancement factor of water vapour in air (Ciddor 1996 / CIPM-2007); transcription not re-read

compressibility.units: a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, c0, c1, d, e of Z(p, T, x_w)
compressibility.source: compressibility factor of moist air (Ciddor 1996 / CIPM-2007); transcription not re-read

referenceStates.source: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566 (1996) reference states of the density ratios
